scripts.build: bun run build:wasm && bun run build:ui
scripts.serve: bun -e "const d='web/dist'; const s=Bun.serve({port:Number(process.env.PORT||5173),fetch(r){const p=new URL(r.url).pathname;return new Response(Bun.file(d+(p==='/'?'/index.html':p.replaceAll('..',''))))}}); console.log('Nexia-List: '+s.url)"
scripts.test: bun run test:rust && bun run test:ui
scripts.test:e2e: cd tests/e2e && bun install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts && bun test --timeout 120000 app.test.js
scripts.bench:e2e: cd tests/e2e && bun install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts && bun test --timeout 600000 perf.test.js
scripts.lint: biome lint scripts ui/tests ui/host tests/e2e web
scripts.fmt: biome format --write scripts ui/tests ui/host tests/e2e web && cd core && cargo fmt
scripts.fmt:check: biome format scripts ui/tests ui/host tests/e2e web && cargo fmt --check
